---
title: "Mermaid fig-align"
# bd-2pmjmjmj: `%%| fig-align` aligns a diagram in every position, with
# no Q-2-47. Q1 diverts the cell option to the `.cell` div's
# `layout-align`, where only panel layouts read it, so this deliberately
# goes further than Q1:
#
# - a numbered float and an unlabelled captioned figure take the class
#   on their `quarto-figure` wrapper, harvested from the diagram the way
#   an image's `fig-align` is (and stripped from the diagram itself);
# - a bare diagram has no wrapper, so the class lands on the <pre>;
# - `default` means `center`; a diagram without the option keeps the
#   plain `<pre class="mermaid">`.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: "Q-2-4[78]|Q-2-57"
        negate: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "div#fig-right.quarto-figure-right pre.mermaid",
            "div.quarto-figure.quarto-figure-left > figure > pre.mermaid",
            "pre.mermaid.quarto-figure-right",
            "pre.mermaid.quarto-figure-center",
          ]
        - ["div#fig-right.quarto-figure-center", "pre.mermaid[fig-align]", "pre.mermaid[data-fig-align]"]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ["<pre class=\"mermaid\">\nflowchart LR\n  plain"]
        - ["%%\\| fig-align"]
---

```mermaid
%%| label: fig-right
%%| fig-cap: A numbered float, aligned right.
%%| fig-align: right
flowchart LR
  a --> b
```

```mermaid
%%| fig-cap: An unnumbered figure, aligned left.
%%| fig-align: left
flowchart LR
  c --> d
```

```mermaid
%%| fig-align: right
flowchart LR
  bare --> right
```

```mermaid
%%| fig-align: default
flowchart LR
  bare --> default
```

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  plain --> diagram
```
